caseNameFull: LINCOLN C. ANDREWS v. United States
disposition: The decision of the court below is affirmed.
syllabus: At a former trial of this case the petition was dismissed, and it will be found fully reported in 47 C. Gls., page 51. The plaintiff makes a motion for a new trial, alleging error of law, and after further and more consideration of the legal question involved, a new trial is granted and a judgment rendered in favor of the plaintiff under authority of the case of Glavey v. United States, 187 XT. S., 595.

opinions.author: White

Mr. Chief Justice White
